class.name: TamaBulletRegistry
class.brief_description: A Resource that maps bullet type names to scenes and server configs.
class.description:
[b]TamaBulletRegistry[/b] holds the full set of bullet types known to Tama. It can be configured imperatively via [TamaManager] methods, or assembled as a [Resource] asset and assigned to [method TamaManager.set_registry].
[b]entries[/b] maps type name strings to [PackedScene] resources for scene-based bullets.
[b]server_configs[/b] maps type name strings to [TamaServerBulletConfig] resources for server (MultiMesh) bullets.
When a TamaScript fires a bullet whose type is not found in either dictionary, [member default_bullet] is used as a fallback.

method.name: get_server_config
method.description: Returns the [TamaServerBulletConfig] registered under [param type], or [code]null[/code] if none is found.

members.member: Maps bullet type names ([String]) to [PackedScene] resources. Used for scene-based bullets.
